name: Neon Conduit Physiology
description: (Tag:movement)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) Wield Neon Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and briefly become Neon, greatly augmenting speed, and absorb Neon Light to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. Note: You do not move at or near light speed. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques.
